item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The IAEA country record shows the DRC's Convention on the Physical Protection of Nuclear Material agreement in force from 21 October 2004; lists the Convention on Early Notification of a Nuclear Accident and the Convention on Assistance in the Case of a Nuclear Accident or Radiological Emergency with signatures dated 30 September 1986; records acceptance of the AFRA agreement on 27 September 2023; and lists an NPT safeguards agreement in force from 9 November 1972 and an Additional Protocol in force from 9 April 2003, with a signature dated 9 April 2003.","notes":["The excerpt lists the two accident-related conventions as signed, but does not state that they were not ratified.","The CPPNM entry supports an in-force date, but does not use the word 'party'."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0017-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
